5\. Rejected consults fill the kit directory 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
_consult_command leaves the permanently linked attachment in kit_dir when UTF-8 decoding or the
final consultation check refuses it. Repeated authenticated requests with invalid text, or requests
refused after a state change during download, accumulate files even though no consultation starts.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A phone consult can retain a downloaded attachment after refusing the command, allowing unused files to accumulate. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/phone.py[617-632] - src/hands/phone.py[1034-1043] ## Recommended Fix Track the path returned by `_fetch` and remove that specific newly written file if decoding or `start_consult` fails. Preserve attachments for successfully started consultations. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
